Deployment failed with the following error:
~~~
Environment Variable "TURSO_DATABASE_URL" references Secret "turso_database_url", which does not exist.
~~~
Learn More: https://vercel.com/docs/environment-variables

> @copilot 不是这个，是studio

Fixed in 617d8ca — reverted the app-host changes and applied the memory→turso migration to `apps/studio/api/index.ts` instead. The Vercel serverless API now uses `TursoDriver` with `TURSO_DATABASE_URL` and `TURSO_AUTH_TOKEN` env vars. The browser MSW mock kernel (`createKernel.ts`) remains on `InMemoryDriver`.
